items.t: Sponsored the Regaining Iowa Farmers' Independence Plan with Rep. J.D. Scholten in the Iowa House, including a Right to Repair bill that passed the House.
items.q: He partnered with the Ranking Member of the Iowa House Agriculture Committee (and Turek endorser) Rep. J.D. Scholten to sponsor the Regaining Iowa Farmers’ Independence Plan. One key aspect of the plan, a Right to Repair bill, recently passed the House with bipartisan support.

items.t: Is against gender transition surgeries for minors.
items.q: Democratic nominee state Rep. Josh Turek has expressed opposition to biological males competing in women's sports and gender transition surgeries for minors after facing Republican criticism.

items.t: Said he does not believe that biological males should compete against females in sports (2026).
items.q: I don’t believe that biological males should compete against females in sports," Turek told The New York Times in July.

bio: Josh Turek is a two-time Paralympic gold medalist for Team USA and a State Legislator who represents the reddest seat held by a Democrat in the state of Iowa. Born with spina bifida after his dad was exposed to Agent Orange in Vietnam, Josh overcame 21 surgeries by the age of 12 to eventually represent the U.S. at four Paralympics.
